title: Finite branch-and-merge constructor for a complete f83r display
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. A complete 33-group ZL3b/P12-like f83r.25-30 display is reduced by one finite constructor: reusable parts open opaque registers, update them, attach effects, guard prior events, bind participants, and resume references. The same executable rule predicts a second exposed paragraph and its residual debt. This is a target-side exploratory writer hypothesis, not a translation or a claim about IT2a coverage.

design.phase: Bounded raw supply; no fixed test, decoder, experiment or selection.
design.epistemic_boundary: Parts, operations, register identities and typed arguments are freely hypothesized. No component has an English meaning, and no source narrative is being transferred to the manuscript.
design.access: Only existing exposed report-owned text and existing dossiers were used. No new target data, image, mixed TSV, reserve, sealed folio, f84/f84r/f116v access, contact, route, ledger or publication.

target.scope: ZL3b/P12-like complete display f83r.25-30, 33 groups, copied from research_registry/proposals/translation_programs_20260912/work/P12/READING_L1.md.

records.raw: qokeedy qolchey qokeey qokedy chedy otal
otchey qokeey qoky tol shedy qokylddy
saiin cheeky sheey qokedy shedy oldy

target.boundary_warning: IT2a has a separate f83r.25-44 paragraph with 92 groups. It is not silently treated as the same paragraph and remains coverage debt; ZL3b/IT2a/RF1b are alternate readings of one manuscript.

design.mechanism: Longest-first segmentation uses one finite inventory of reusable surface parts. qok allocates and updates a register; suffix frames choose UPDATE, CONTINUE_UPDATE or GUARDED_UPDATE. che/chey attach EFFECT or LINK; ot guards; sh binds a participant; ckh marks a list item; da opens an ordered branch; sa and qo reference the current register or state; kes negates the prior event; ol resumes an owner reference; o renews; t locates; s opens the topic. Context supplies register and participant identity, never a fitted whole-form value.
design.residual_rule: If a token cannot be fully segmented, emit one opaque residual class R(first_character, token_length mod 2, vowel_count mod 3), shared by that class. P1 has zero residuals; the rule is not a free per-token glossary.
design.worked_consequence: The six lines derive UPDATE/RELATE/EFFECT/GUARD, ordered participant branches, state/reference resumes, negation and a closing renewal/reference chain. Replacing qok register allocation by in-place mutation changes downstream register count and identity; allowing occurrence-specific whole outputs removes the predicted shared roles. These are observable consequences of the constructor, not decipherment scores.
design.prediction: Applying the unchanged reducer to the already exposed f83r.9-17 paragraph yields 84 groups, 11 registers, 9 participants and 3 branches but 32 residual events across 20 classes. A real shared writer would need stable qok/che/sh/ot role signatures and controlled residual reuse; this increase is a direct warning against selecting from P1 alone.
design.contrast: This differs from IDEA414's Balneis-derived state/effect renderer, from IDEA398/128's source-only Llull correlatives/chamber tables, and from occurrence-specific whole-form fitting. It does not inherit qokeedy or other old content glosses.
costs_and_limits: Initial register context, role labels, frame inventory and residual signature are guessed.
The six-line P1 display is fully segmented under the declared inventory, so compactness is not independent evidence of meaning.
The P2 residual increase and separate IT2a boundary leave substantial coverage and writer-identification debt.
The model supplies no independently known participants, objects, language or historical source relation.
